Class WayangAssistantService

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.assistant.agent.WayangAssistantService
@ApplicationScoped public class WayangAssistantService extends Object
Lean facade for the Wayang Internal Assistant. Orchestrates specialized services for session management, intent classification, documentation search, and project generation.
